# AP2 v0.2 schema evidence

These files are unmodified copies of `code/sdk/schemas/ap2` from Google
Agentic Commerce AP2 release `v0.2.0`, commit
`b4587ac1d055888a73b4b21750973cffba961793`.

Sompi verifies each file's exact SHA-256 digest before registering it. The
normative digest list and schema-loading code live in
`src/adapters/ap2/schemas.ts`; the pinned profile is documented in
`docs/architecture/AP2_PROFILE.md`.

The upstream files are licensed under Apache License 2.0. See `LICENSE` in
this directory. Sompi's own code remains under the repository MIT licence.
